opening_message: In ORD-7216, I need the shirt swapped for a larger size. The book is fine.

task_rules: Keep the request scoped to exchanging only the shirt in ORD-7216 for the Large size; the book should remain delivered and unchanged.
Provide the order ID when asked, and clarify that the shirt is the item to exchange while the book is fine only if the agent needs item scope.
If the agent asks for product, policy, stock, item ID, fee, or exchange eligibility facts you do not know, ask them to check the order records or tools.
Push back if the agent proposes returning, refunding, cancelling, or changing the whole order, the book, or any item other than the shirt.
Push back if the agent proposes a return-and-rebuy, refund, goodwill credit, or a different replacement instead of a direct exchange to Premium Cotton Shirt (Large).
Accept only after the preview confirms the shirt will be exchanged for Premium Cotton Shirt (Large) and the book will remain unchanged.
If the agent asks for confirmation before giving a matching preview, ask them to first confirm the replacement item and that the book is not affected.
End only after the exchange has been processed and the final confirmation still shows the shirt exchanged to Large with the book unchanged.
